title: Sustainable Corporate Innovation and Digital Business Resilience: Examining Managerial Responses to Global Market Disruptions
content: This study examines the link between sustainable corporate Innovation and digital business resilience in the face of global market disruptions from 2021 to 2026, and how managers respond. While previous studies have focused on the elements of sustainability and digital transformation or resilience, there is a lack of focus on the dynamic interplay between these elements within sectors and over time. This study draws on a framework of dynamic capabilities and organizational learning and suggests a proposed relationship between sustainable innovation and resilience outcomes that is mediated by managerial responses. A multiple-case study design is followed, with secondary data that are gathered from corporate reports, industry publications, and academic case studies in the manufacturing, services, and technology industries. Patterns around capability development and adaptation are identified through thematic analysis and cross-case synthesis. The results show that the managerial response is key to sustainable Innovation being realized as resilience, and that there are differences among sectors and a clear timeline of reactive to proactive and AI-based. The study is of theoretical significance because of the integration of sustainability, Innovation, and resilience.
